summary: Frontend-only Playwright E2E re-test of IRON CALCULATOR premium upgrade. All 11 review-request features VERIFIED PASS. Hero scroll, AI loader (data-testid='ai-loader'), result dashboard with all 35 required testids, calculation correctness (BMR=1728, TDEE=2678, target=2678, BMI=23.7, lean mass=58.9 kg Boer, bodyfat=18.7% Deurenberg, water=2.9 L), email mock flow (invalid blocked, valid shows coach-email-success), theme toggle (dark <-> light with html.dark class toggling), recalculate scroll, both PDF buttons trigger downloads with zero JS errors, localStorage persistence across reload, ProgressionChart Recharts no width(-1)/height(-1) warnings. 0 console errors total.
critical_code_review_comments: calculations.js: All formulas verified correct — BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor), BMI, Boer lean mass, Deurenberg bodyfat, hydration (35 ml/kg + 500 ml/training/7), target weight, weeks-to-goal.
ProgressionChart.jsx now sets minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer + explicit h-72 wrapper, eliminating Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings observed in iteration_1.
CoachMode email validation regex /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ correctly rejects 'notanemail' and accepts 'me@test.com'. Mock-only (no backend) — clearly flagged.
LoadingScreen total ~1.35s (1.1s steps + 0.25s exit) — matches review's ~1.4s expectation.
PDF generation via jsPDF runs purely client-side; no console errors triggered on either download-pdf-btn or coach-pdf-btn click.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium upgrade fully verified. All 35 data-testids present.
